capabilities.name: Universal Checkpoint Framework
capabilities.objective: Automatically establish deterministic, self-contained execution checkpoints from which execution can be resumed.
capabilities.reuse: The runtime execution platform already realises deterministic, byte-identical, resumable checkpoints (EPIC-RTE-002) and repository operations already persist a config-digest-keyed resumable checkpoint; the master recovery instrument already defines the append-only session checkpoint format and store. This programme binds them; it introduces no new checkpoint mechanism.

capabilities.name: Universal Execution Journal
capabilities.objective: Record every decision, write, validation, certification, checkpoint, interruption and recovery as append-only repository evidence.
capabilities.reuse: The execution platform already records an ordered audit log; governance telemetry already owns the single append-only audit history with one writer, one monotonic sequence and atomic writes; the master execution and traceability instruments already journal every capability transition. This programme binds them as the execution journal.

capabilities.name: Universal Recovery Engine
capabilities.objective: Detect interruption, verify the repository, locate the latest checkpoint, verify completed work, detect partial writes, finish only incomplete work, and continue — never restarting from the beginning unless integrity cannot be recovered.
capabilities.reuse: The execution platform already computes the last consistent recovery point and recovers-and-continues from it, reusing checkpoint and continuation verbatim; the master recovery instrument already defines the recovery decision tree, the recovery procedures and crash/repository recovery. This programme binds them; it introduces no new recovery mechanism.

capabilities.name: Universal Atomic Write Framework
capabilities.objective: Perform every large write as a constitutional atomic operation — generate, validate, write, verify, checkpoint, continue — never assuming a write succeeded, always verifying.
capabilities.reuse: Governance telemetry already performs atomic writes (temp file + os.replace) so a concurrent reader never observes a half-written record; repository operations already write checkpoints deterministically with sorted keys; execution persistence already provides canonical serialisation and verified restoration. This programme binds them as the atomic-write flow.

capabilities.name: Universal Resume Framework
capabilities.objective: Automatically resume from the last verified checkpoint, never regenerating completed artefacts, never overwriting verified work, never duplicating execution.
capabilities.reuse: The execution platform already resumes a run from any checkpoint and verifies the resumed run reproduces the original per-universe state; repository operations already skip PASSED stages on a resumed run; the master recovery instrument already defines the session continuation contract. This programme binds them; it introduces no new resume mechanism.

capabilities.name: Universal Work Package Ledger
capabilities.objective: Record for every work package its identifier, objective, dependencies, execution status, validation status, certification status, checkpoint reference and completion evidence.
capabilities.reuse: The master execution instrument already carries the executable work-package program (MEP rows) with dependencies, acceptance/exit criteria, state and per-transition completion evidence; the decision-assimilation programme already registers implementation work packages with owner, route and acceptance; the machine state mirror already records the frontier. This programme binds them as the work-package ledger.

capabilities.name: Universal Continuation Package
capabilities.objective: Automatically generate the continuation package (repository state, completed work, remaining work, current checkpoint, dependency state, open issues, architectural decisions, implementation roadmap, recommended next programme) as the mandatory input to the next autonomous session.
capabilities.reuse: The master state instrument already records where we are and the Next Authorized Capability; the append-only checkpoints are already self-contained resume anchors that, with git log, fully reconstruct operational context; the master recovery instrument already guarantees the checkpoint is a redundant continuation anchor. This programme binds them as the continuation package and emits its own (deliverable 13).

capabilities.name: Universal Replay Protection
capabilities.objective: Detect and prevent duplicated execution, generation, artefacts, implementation and writes.
capabilities.reuse: The execution platform already replays a run and validates it reproduces the original byte-for-byte; the determinism workflow already double-builds and diffs; the registration authority already runs a drift/duplication guard; the master execution instrument already records that recovered work reuses intact certified evidence and regenerates no artefact. This programme binds them as replay protection.

capabilities.name: Universal Repository Safety
capabilities.objective: Before every write, verify the repository, dependency integrity, the target artefact, constitutional authority, duplication and the checkpoint.
capabilities.reuse: The master recovery instrument already mandates the boot repository-verification sequence; the aggregate gate declaration already binds repository health, graph invariants, the registration drift guard and the verification entry point; the verification entry point and Makefile already run the fail-closed gate before any change lands. This programme binds them as repository safety and adds its own forbidden-write scope guard.

capabilities.name: Universal Execution Health Intelligence
capabilities.objective: Continuously evaluate execution stability, interruption frequency, recovery success, checkpoint quality, repository integrity, execution confidence and completion confidence.
capabilities.reuse: The execution platform already provides a deterministic three-valued health assessment, diagnostics with findings, metrics and monitoring; the master dashboard already records programme completion metrics. This programme binds them as execution-health intelligence.

continuation.architectural_decisions: Reuse-first, zero-duplication: no new checkpoint, journal, recovery, atomic-write, resume, ledger, continuation, replay, safety or health engine was created; every capability is bound to its existing home. The programme is delivered in the canonical UCDA/UCCEP executable-governance archetype (data-driven engine, no timestamps, byte-identical determinism, writes confined to its own operational memory).
